svg.title: FFALCON bird emblem — launcher redraw
svg.desc: Geometric vector redraw of the bird emblem in TCL Multimedia's 10 April 2017 press release, page 2. https://doc.irasia.com/listco/hk/tclelectronics/press/p170410.pdf . Trademark belongs to its owner; no affiliation or permission is implied. Not an official vector master.
